description: This file provides utility functions for managing browser notifications, including showing notifications, checking support, requesting permissions, and handling notification permission states within a Mattermost web application.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Displays a browser notification with specified parameters, handling permission requests and platform differences.

methods.name: isNotificationAPISupported
methods.description: Checks if the Notification API is supported in the current browser environment.

methods.name: getNotificationPermission
methods.description: Returns the current notification permission status.

methods.name: requestNotificationPermission
methods.description: Requests permission from the user to show notifications.
